from PIL import Image
import os, numpy as np
# find file likely cwd
print(os.getcwd(), os.path.exists('1081768.fig3.jpg'))
im=Image.open('1081768.fig3.jpg').convert('RGB')
a=np.array(im); print(im.size,a.shape)
# panel A rough
# red threshold dark red, blue dark blue
R,G,B=a[:,:,0],a[:,:,1],a[:,:,2]
red=(R>100)&(R<180)&(G<80)&(B<80)
blue=(B>80)&(R<80)&(G<100)
# restrict panel A x<260 y 70:280
for name,mask in [('red',red),('blue',blue)]:
 ys,xs=np.where(mask & (np.indices(red.shape)[1]<260) & (np.indices(red.shape)[0]>70) & (np.indices(red.shape)[0]<280))
 print(name,len(xs), (xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max()) if len(xs) else None)
 # connected components simple
 seen=np.zeros(mask.shape,bool); comps=[]
 for x,y in zip(xs,ys):
  if seen[y,x]: continue
  stack=[(x,y)]; seen[y,x]=1; pts=[]
  while stack:
   X,Y=stack.pop(); pts.append((X,Y))
   for XX in range(max(0,X-2),min(a.shape[1],X+3)):
    for YY in range(max(0,Y-2),min(a.shape[0],Y+3)):
     if mask[YY,XX] and not seen[YY,XX]: seen[YY,XX]=1;stack.append((XX,YY))
  comps.append(pts)
 print('components',len(comps), sorted([(len(p),np.mean([q[0] for q in p]),np.mean([q[1] for q in p])) for p in comps], reverse=True)[:10])
